title: The corrupt-archive recovery step names summary.terminal_evidence.reason, the field change status --json actually prints (#966)
description: The corrupt-archive recovery step names summary.terminal_evidence.reason, the field change status --json actually prints (#966)
acceptance_criteria: When a corrupt archive's package still matches the commit that archived it, the recovery step change status prints names summary.terminal_evidence.reason, and reading that exact path from change status --json gives a non-empty reason (#966, CHANGE-7.a.2)

answers.constraints: The recovery step stays built from literals, the change ID and the package path only, never a digest, with every interpolated word shell-quoted (REQ-change-093); only the field path in the OutsidePackage step changes
